items.raw_excerpt: Most young people leaving home in the Netherlands head to Amsterdam, according to new figures from national statistics office CBS. More than 174,000 people aged 18 to 30 moved out of their parents’ home in 2024, and a third of them settled in Amsterdam, one of ten councils tracked by the research. The city drew 12,760, well ahead of Rotterdam and Groningen. The city was also the most popular destination for students, attracting 5,475, followed by Utrecht and Groningen. Nijmegen...
